title: S006 2.2.1 Client Protocol Sender and Server Protocol Receiver
parent_path: S006 2.2.1 Client Protocol Sender and Server Protocol Receiver

statements.subject: session
statements.description: the command continuation request is still pending; the client takes the appropriate action for the response and reads another response from the server

statements.subject: server
statements.description: the server sends a command continuation request response if it is ready for the octets (if appropriate) and the remainder of the command. This response is prefixed with the token "+".
actions: server sends continuation request response prefixed with "+"

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If, instead, the server detected an error in the command, it sends a BAD completion response with a tag matching the command to reject the command and prevent the client from sending any more of the command.
actions: server sends BAD completion response with matching tag

statements.subject: client
statements.description: the client MUST send a complete command (including receiving all command continuation request responses and sending command continuations for the command) before initiating a new command.
